data_fields.name: ambush_chance
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.1 (5 villages) or 0.05 (3 villages) in data_free/game_config/enemies.txt; code default 0.0

best_idea: When a party crosses a zone border, place each member on the border that faces the way they came in, fall back through a fixed widening search, and show one list of members who could not come, which the player confirms or cancels as a whole.
decision_why: Direction-aware border landing and the one-list leave-behind fit zones as data on one runtime; the separate engine per site is rejected as a shape, and the frozen zone clock needs absolute due-times to fit row 23.
acceptance: Walking east out of zone A puts the party on zone B's west border in the same band; a turned-off member appears once in the leave-behind list; declining leaves every member in zone A; a server test asserts an empty zone's respawn timer resolves on re-entry instead of freezing.
